bullets.text: Under course supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the programming question metadata workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under course supervision, validated SQL joins on provided programming question metadata tables using duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.

As an individual contribution to supervised research, implemented reusable Python modules for the product review metadata workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

As an individual contribution to supervised research, validated SQL joins on provided product metadata tables with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
